summary: Iter74 — Full backend + frontend verification of Orisei Truck Cleaning fleet unit registry, AI efficiency schedule, and AI offer engine. Backend: 15/15 new pytest tests pass in test_iter74_tc_fleet_offers.py covering GET /units (seed + metrics shape + fleets rollup), client_id filter, POST /units (404 unknown client, cadence 0 derives from client plan = 14|21|30, never_cleaned initial status), POST /units/{id}/clean (metrics update — total_cleans=1, status fresh, days_since=0), POST /units/{id}/cadence (3-120 guard: rejects 2 and 121 with 400, accepts 30 and persists), 404 on unknown unit, DELETE /units (200 + repeat 404). AI schedule: GET /ai-schedule?ai=false returns capacity_per_day=27 (3 techs*9), 7-day plan, one client per day (no client dupes on same day), day.cabs = sum(stops.cabs); days=2 clamps to 3 buckets. Offers: /offers returns resend_configured=false + shape ok, POST /offers/{id}/send → 400 with 'resend' in body, /offers/send-all → 400, DELETE /offers/{id} → 200 (repeat 404). AI schedule with ai=true verified via live curl — returned 851-char AI notes within 60s (Claude via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY). Regression: iter72 (31) + iter73 (31) still all pass — 62/62. Frontend: /truck-cleaning admin renders all 13 tabs incl. Fleet Registry (tc-tab-fleet) + AI Offers (tc-tab-offers). Fleet tab: ALL FLEETS pill (6 units), 3 fleet pills, 6 unit cards with status pill + cadence bar; clicking a card opens tc-unit-detail with 3 metric tiles + tc-unit-cadence-input + tc-unit-cadence-save (cadence updated), Mark Cleaned Today + Remove. Add Unit reveals tc-unit-form. AI Efficiency Schedule (tc-ai-schedule-btn) rendered 3 day columns in ~15s and tc-ai-notes populated with 4-bullet AI insights. AI Offers tab: shows Resend-needed notice, tc-offers-scrub-btn present, 5 existing draft offer rows load with angle chips (UPSELL BUNDLE, SUB UPGRADE) + DRAFT status; tc-offer-preview-* opens tc-offer-preview-dialog with subject/body; Send on draft correctly surfaces 'Resend is not configured — add your Resend API key in Connections · Keys.' toast; Send All (4) button visible and errors gracefully with same Resend toast; delete removes row (5→4). Regression quick pass: Scheduler tab (tc-scheduler), Jobs tab (tc-run-reminders-btn), Invoices (tc-invoices), Doc Vault (tc-vault), Cleaning Guide all render.

issues: When offers list is fetching, the empty-state 'No offers yet — hit "AI Scrub Client List"' briefly flashes before data arrives. Consider a small loading skeleton or defer empty-state message by 200ms to avoid the flicker.

action_items: None blocking. Optional UX polish: add loading skeleton to Offers table to hide the empty-state flash while /offers loads.
critical_code_review_comments: truck_cleaning_fleet.py _seed_units correctly gates on count==0 (idempotent) and only seeds up to 3 clients × 3 cabs — clean bounded seed.
POST /units/{id}/cadence validates 3<=days<=120 before hitting Mongo — good. However set_cadence accepts a raw Dict[str,int] instead of a Pydantic model — consider a CadenceIn model for consistency.

ai_schedule plan-packing greedily assigns groups to the lightest day; capacity overflow only triggers a re-min-day pick — for small fleets this is fine but with dozens of clients a single yard could still exceed capacity. Acceptable MVP.
scrub uses a HARD 4000-char body cap and 180-char subject cap — good defensive slicing before Mongo write.
scrub deletes prior drafts per client (tc_offers.delete_many status=draft) before insert — prevents duplicate drafts on re-scrub. Correct.
_ai_notes catches all exceptions and returns '' — matches spec ('empty string acceptable on LLM failure').
_public_base import from truck_cleaning_field is unused in fleet router — safe to remove.

resend.api_key is set as a module-level attr each send; if two send-all calls run concurrently with different api_keys it could race — very unlikely in single-tenant admin flow but worth a wrapper if multi-tenancy is added.

TcFleet.jsx uses `m.days_since / m.cadence_days` for progress bar without guarding cadence_days=0 — currently backend defaults to 21 so safe, but a defensive `|| 21` on the frontend would prevent NaN if cadence were ever 0.
TcOffers.jsx errTxt handles string detail only; if backend ever returns detail as list/dict (FastAPI validation errors), the toast will read 'Something went wrong' — acceptable fallback.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (13 tabs, fleet cards + detail dialog + cadence save, AI schedule with AI notes, offers preview + send Resend-error + send-all Resend-error + delete)
